question: Should the next stage reuse clean lane worktrees or create new ones?
reason: The Owner needs a simple choice before the Controller prepares the next stage baseline.
recommendation_reason: reuse keeps the workflow simpler when worktrees are clean and aligned
what_changes: The Controller either keeps the current lane directories or plans new ones.
main_risk: Reusing a dirty or misaligned worktree could carry stale state into the next stage.

options.title: Reuse clean aligned worktrees
options.owner_impact: Fewer directories and a faster next-stage start.
options.delivery_impact: Controller verifies cleanliness and baseline alignment first.
options.risk: Must stop if any worktree is dirty or misaligned.
options.future_impact: Keeps a stable lane directory layout.

options.title: Create new lane worktrees
options.delivery_impact: Controller plans new paths and branch names.
options.risk: More cleanup and branch tracking later.
options.future_impact: Keeps the old stage directories available for investigation.
